name: Sampath Bank
blocked: The list API is reachable and its shape is known from the site's own bundle: GET /api/card-promotions?category=<tab>&page_number=<n>&size=<n> returns {data, page_number, size, total}. The filter works, so total is right (15 for super_markets), but data is always an empty array, and /api/card-promotions/<id> returns {}. No header, locale, referer or origin changed that, and the API base is the site itself, so the rows are filtered server side by something a plain client cannot supply. The rendered pages are a Nuxt SPA whose listing carries no offer text either, and the detail routes answer 500. This needs a browser session.
